data.title: W Residences
data.about:
W Residences 3 is the third tower in the iconic W Residences by Arada. Located in Dubai Harbour, the development presents a refined blend of luxury, comfort, and lifestyle-driven living. This landmark project reflects Arada’s vision of creating world-class residences with a focus on exclusivity and elegance.

The project features an exceptional collection of properties, including 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, 2 to 4-bedroom duplexes, 5-bedroom penthouses, and a 5-bedroom presidential suite. Residents benefit from high-end facilities such as an infinity pool, a residence lounge, a wellness spa, and a state-of-the-art gym, all set against panoramic waterfront views.

characteristics_module.title: W Residences 3 Dubai Harbour – A Seafront Landmark of Modern Luxury
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Location - Positioned at Dubai Harbour, offering captivating views of Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, and Bluewaters Island.
  • Properties - Wide selection of apartments, duplexes, penthouses, and a Presidential Suite with unmatched waterfront vistas.
  • Amenities - Infinity pool, Residence Lounge, wellness spa, yoga studio, kids’ club, games room, and marina access.
  • Developer - Created by Arada Developments, a leading name known for quality and progressive urban design.
  • Attractive Pricing - Entry point into a high-demand luxury waterfront market with flexible payment options.
  • 10% Down Payment - Secure your residence with an accessible entry payment and easy installment plan.
  • High Capital Appreciation - Prime location and limited supply ensure strong returns for investors over time.
  • Exclusive Lifestyle - Smart home features, 24-hour concierge, and access to Dubai Harbour’s largest marina.

location_tile.title: Waterfront Living with Seamless City Access
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The W Residences 3 location in Dubai Harbour offers direct views of the Arabian Gulf and easy connectivity via Sheikh Zayed Road (E11). Residents enjoy close proximity to leisure, shopping, and business hubs, while living in Dubai’s premier marina lifestyle community.

  • 6 Minutes – Dubai Marina Walk
  • 10 Minutes – Dubai Internet City
  • 12 Minutes – Palm Jumeirah
  • 14 Minutes – Mall of the Emirates
  • 19 Minutes – Business Bay
  • 20 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
